title: Vegan Cream of Asparagus Soup
description: This is a delicious cream of asparagus soup with coconut milk, cashews, and herbs like rosemary and thyme. Lemon juice adds a fresh taste.
ingredients: 1.5 teaspoons salt, or more to taste
2 pounds fresh asparagus, trimmed and cut into 2-inch pieces
1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley for garnish

steps.text: Combine coconut oil and onion in a large pot over medium heat and cook, stirring occasionally, until onion is soft and translucent, about 5 minutes. Stir in garlic, salt, rosemary, thyme, and pepper; cook for 1 to 2 minutes. Add asparagus. Cook and stir over medium heat for 5 minutes.

Reduce heat to medium-low and add cashews, vegetable broth, and coconut milk. Bring to a low boil, cover, and simmer until asparagus is tender, 7 to 10 minutes. Turn off heat and stir in lemon juice. Let stand until cooled slightly.
Puree asparagus soup using an immersion blender until smooth. Garnish with chopped parsley.
